original_decision.evidence: Approved regular end projections make relative stationary collars possible. Degree43 ambient monomials prescribe order-three jets independently at up to six distinct points. Cusp codimension2 and extra degeneracy3, double equality2/tangency3, triple equality4 and quadruple6 give the right dimensions. Combined same-time events have excess codimension; overlaps are excluded degeneracies. Ordinary cusp/monotone neighbourhoods control deleted diagonals and finiteness. Crossing continuation and finite edge/collar velocity construction yield actual planar ambient isotopy. AC_omega is exactly parametric transversality/null unions. Exact recovered old-body issue: The pre-reader fixed arbitrary stationary endpoint projections while promising generic slices except finitely many times. For F(theta,t)=(cos(theta),0,sin(theta)), fixed projection (x,y) has vertical tangencies at every time in the fixed collars, so that promise is impossible. Its proof additionally substituted pointwise submersivity for independent multijet control and misstated triple codimension. Preserved closed repair: The owner separately approved regular endpoint projections. The current degree43 family controls independent order-three jets at six points; correct cusp/fold/triple/quadruple and coincidence codimensions, deleted-diagonal analysis and actual planar extension prove the full genericity conclusion under unchanged AC_omega. Only old contract bytes remain unknown; that uncertainty does not waive this concrete defect. original_decision.evidence: The ordinary cusp has the two determinant conditions, giving one crossing versus none and nonzero spatial third derivative at the cusp. A quadratic graph difference q has q_vv and q_t nonzero, giving zero/two roots and opposite RII signs; an affine difference would not. Transverse triple equality carries three crossings across one another with consistent spatial height order. Finitely many mutually distinct events and regular intervals assemble the exact oriented move sequence. Exact recovered old-body issue: The pre-reader R2 proof used an affine normal difference and asserted it creates two intersections. An affine function in the spatial coordinate has at most one root, so it cannot prove a two-crossing birth/death. Its cusp and triple descriptions lacked the actual needed local determinant/height conditions. Preserved closed repair: The current proof uses q=q_v=0, q_vv and q_t nonzero for zero/two roots, the ordinary cusp determinants and nonzero third-coordinate derivative, and a transverse triple with consistent total height order. These give the exact three oriented moves. Only old contract bytes remain unknown; that uncertainty does not waive this concrete defect.
